query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
# This workflow will install Python dependencies, run tests and lint with a single version of Python
# For more information see: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/automating-builds-and-tests/building-and-testing-python

name: CI testing

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "master", "dev" ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run: 
        shell: bash -el {0}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: conda-incubator/setup-miniconda@v3
      with:
          miniforge-version: latest
          channels: conda-forge,bioconda
          channel-priority: true

    - name: install dependancies
      run: |
        wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jodyphelan/TBProfiler/dev/conda/linux-latest.txt
        conda create --name test --file linux-latest.txt
      
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        conda activate test
        pip install --force-reinstall git+https://github.com/jodyphelan/pathogen-profiler.git@dev
        pip install --force-reinstall .
        pip install semver
    
    - name: remove redundant snpeff files
      run: |
        rm -r /home/runner/miniconda3/envs/test/share/snpeff-5.2-1

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        cd db
        python ../tb-profiler load_library tbdb
        cd ../tests
        mamba install pytest pandas importlib_resources -y
        pytest -x . --log-level=INFO
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

results.content:
:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          submodules: recursive
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97  # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install '.[dev]'
      - name: Run tests
        env:
          SPEAKEASY_ENABLE_GDB_TESTS: "1"
        run: pytest tests/

Cancel superseded runs

Pattern: P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (stale_run_cancellation)

When is cancel superseded runs applicable?

Assess cancel superseded runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Runs represent the same workflow and branch or PR; A newer revision supersedes older checks

Contraindications: Release or deployment work; Distinct branches share a cancellation group

Method: Partition cancellation by workflow and branch/PR; Preserve run identity and audit records

Reported finding: Superseding runs can reduce duplicate work.

Reported metrics: {"vm_time_reduction_percent": {"free": 1.9, "paid": 4.1}}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
